findings.claim: The projector reports readiness immediately after subscribing, before replaying any retained broker backlog, so `/readyz` can go healthy while GetEntity still serves stale projection state.
findings.evidence: Acceptance requires establishing "snapshot-to-WAL catch-up and readiness so existing GetEntity/WatchEntity reflect production ingestion"; `run_until_shutdown` calls `readiness.send_replace(true);` directly after `broker.subscribe(...)` and before any `stream.next()` item is applied.
findings.suggested_fix: Delay projector readiness until the subscription has caught up to the broker high-water mark or otherwise prove no backlog remains before publishing `true`.

findings.claim: Several error paths inside an open SurrealDB transaction return without cancelling the transaction, risking leaked or dangling transactional state on validation failures.
findings.evidence: `apply_projection` explicitly calls `transaction.cancel().await` for epoch mismatch, duplicate, and missing initial history, but the later missing-base update path returns `Err(PortError::NotFound(...))` without cancel after `let previous = ...`; subsequent `merge_object(...)` and `EntityRow::from_change(...)` errors also return before `transaction.commit()` with no cancel.
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure every pre-commit error path cancels the transaction, or wrap transaction handling in a guard that cancels on drop unless committed.

findings.claim: Unsupported floating-point values are silently projected as JSON null instead of failing closed, corrupting entity data without surfacing an error.
findings.evidence: `canonical_to_json` maps `CanonicalValue::Float(value)` through `serde_json::Number::from_f64(value).map_or(serde_json::Value::Null, serde_json::Value::Number)`, so NaN or infinity becomes `null`; the reviewer mandate flags "Silent failure — defaults that mask failure".
findings.suggested_fix: Return `EntityProjectorError::Payload` when `Number::from_f64` returns `None` instead of substituting null.
